## Decision
Adopt the Company Research chapter and **Separate Lenses** as the governing grammar for the homepage use-case worlds.
## Approved characteristics
- Discovery Blue atmosphere with deterministic copy and product proof.
- One example Spotify AB registry result as the recurring proof object.
- Company News and Country Economic Indicators shown only as separate possible next calls.
- Tool-specific inputs, outputs and sources remain distinct.
- Generated imagery contains no UI, values, text, logos or product claims.
- The unsupported funding implication is removed from this composition.
## Boundary
This decision approves the design direction only. It does not authorize website implementation or any outward release.
